title: Present progressive: now and for a while
point: Use am, is or are plus -ing for what is happening right now and for temporary situations around now.

sentences.ja: ちょっと待って、今メール書いてるから。
sentences.text: Hang on, I'm writing an email.

sentences.ja: 今週は兄の家に泊まっています。
sentences.text: I'm staying at my brother's place this week.
sentences.note: A temporary stay takes the progressive; "I live" would sound permanent.

sentences.ja: 彼女は今、卒論に取り組んでいる。
sentences.text: She's working on her thesis at the moment.
sentences.note: "Work on" is the natural verb for an ongoing project.

sentences.ja: 最近、スペイン語を勉強してるんだ。
子どもたちは庭で遊んでいます。
sentences.text: The kids are playing in the yard.

sentences.ja: 今、駅に向かってるところ。
sentences.text: I'm heading to the station now.
sentences.note: "Head to" is the everyday way to say you're on your way somewhere.

sentences.ja: 私たちは今、新しい実験の準備をしています。
sentences.text: We're getting ready for a new experiment right now.

sentences.ja: 物価がどんどん上がっている。
sentences.text: Prices are going up and up.
sentences.note: The progressive also shows a change in progress; どんどん maps to repeating the word.
